## Outcome

Describe the observable result, not only the files to change.

## Design phase and layer

- Phase:
- Layer: Linux core / Android adapter / analytics / storage / tooling

## Scope

List the behavior included in this task.

## Out of scope

List adjacent behavior that must not be added.

## Capability assumptions

List required kernel features, hooks, BTF, privileges, Android versions,
or device constraints.

## Event and contract impact

Describe new or changed schemas, maps, interfaces, and shared hooks.

## Validation

Define the workload, expected result, trusted reference, tolerance, loss
budget, and overhead budget. Identify equivalent Perfetto signals.

## Completion evidence

List the artifacts, tests, measurements, compatibility notes, and
documentation required before the task is complete.
